name: motion-lab
description: Motion Lab — iPhone-first motion graphics editor with cloud rendering

scripts.build: npm run build -w @motion-lab/engine && npm run build -w @motion-lab/web && npm run build -w @motion-lab/render
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @motion-lab/engine && concurrently -n web,render -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @motion-lab/web" "npm run dev -w @motion-lab/render"
